title: Entity Output Switch
text: Entity Output Switch 模块允许您在多个实体输出端口中选择一个输出端口供实体离开，输入 2 路、输出 2 路；按 {Switching criterion} 指定切换准则 First port that is not；{Number of output ports} 输出端口数、{Initial port selection} 指定仿真开始时的输出端口、{Switch Attribute name} 决定输出端口的属性、{Seed} 指定种子，按实例取值。

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 输入实体 scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 输出实体 scalar | vector | matrix

ports.summary: 输出实体 scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Switching criterion
params.values: 选择切换准则 First port that is not blocked (default) | Round robin | From control port | From attribute | Equiprobable

params.name: Initial port selection
params.values: 指定仿真开始时的输出端口 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Switch Attribute name
params.values: 指定决定输出端口的属性 Attribute1 (default) | character vector
